## ISO 9001:2015 — 8.1 Operational planning and control

**Standard / control:** ISO 9001:2015, 8.1 Operational planning and control
**Repository:** `example-org/hub-service` (local clone)
**Baseline:** `development` @ `abc1234` (working tree has one uncommitted change to `web/package-lock.json`; not assessed)
**Sources file:** `implicit git-repo` (no `.xianix/operation-sources.yaml`, `compliance/operation-sources.yaml` or `--sources` found)
**Git scope:** `full repository`
**Products / services in scope:** Hub Service web console (Next.js static export); Hub Service API (.NET — REST + event ingest); public landing page
**Processes in scope:** Requirements and scoping; Design decisions (ADRs); Development; Code review and merge; Build and deploy (API, frontend); Database change (EF migrations); Load / performance verification; Operations and monitoring; Incident handling and rollback
**Report date:** `2026-09-21`
**Overall 8.1 status:** `Gap`

---

### Sources used

| Id | Provider | Roles | Verdict | Artifacts | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| codebase | git-repo | all (implicit fallback) | ok | 31 | Delivery tracker (commit messages reference `HUB-…` ticket keys) and any wiki are not declared, so they were not fetched. |

---

### Summary

Hub Service delivers a team-scoped operations console and API. Operational planning lives in the repository as phase specs with numbered requirements (`docs/specs/phase-2/REQUIREMENTS.md`), 12 dated ADRs (`docs/adr/`), product and design briefs (`PRODUCT.md`, `DESIGN.md`) and contributor rules for people and agents (`AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills/`). Deployment is well controlled: GitHub Actions build immutable images, apply migrations and deploy per environment, with production approval gates documented. The main gaps are on the conformity side. No automated build, test or lint gate runs before merge or deploy, there is no Definition of Done or release acceptance record, no test results or release notes are retained, and there is no written process for incidents, hotfixes or rollback. Because obligation 7 (records of product conformity) is a Gap, the overall 8.1 status is Gap.

---

Requirements aren't linked to acceptance. Standards commitments are undecided (`PRODUCT.md`: WCAG 2.1 AA "undecided"). |
| 2 | Criteria for processes established | Partial | `AGENTS.md` (commit, branch and code conventions), `server/README.md` §5 (deploy order), `.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` | No end-to-end delivery process with entry conditions, roles or measures. Code review criteria exist only as an optional agent skill. |

No named acceptor. Success criteria exist per phase, not per release. |
